operators.name: lp_pool2d_forward

returns.shape: [N, C, floor((H+2*padding_h-kernel_h)/stride)+1, floor((W+2*padding_w-kernel_w)/stride)+1] using floor when ceil_mode=false

semantics: Computes LP pooling: output[n,c,h,w] = (sum_{i,j} input[n,c, h*stride + i - padding_h, w*stride + j - padding_w]^norm_type)^{1/norm_type} over valid i,j in [0,kernel_h-1]x[0,kernel_w-1].

If ceil_mode=true, output size uses ceil division and the last window may extend beyond input; out-of-bounds positions are treated as zero for even norm_type, but this implementation only supports ceil_mode=false.
Padding is zero-padding; values outside input are zero.
norm_type must be positive, but this implementation assumes norm_type=2.
Applies nn.LPPool2d with norm_type=2, kernel_size=(3,5), stride=1, padding=0, ceil_mode=False to input x.
